title: Unit – 2 : Session – 9 : SLO – 1 | Polymorphism Classification
sections: A. area() in both Circle and Rectangle → RUN-TIME POLYMORPHISM (if they share a base class/interface and override area(); resolved by object type at run time)
B. Printer with print(String) and print(int) → COMPILE-TIME POLYMORPHISM (method overloading — chosen by argument types at compile time)
C. Loop printing "Hello" five times → NO POLYMORPHISM (plain iteration)
D. Subclass overrides speak() from superclass → RUN-TIME POLYMORPHISM (overriding)
E. Method that adds two numbers → NO POLYMORPHISM (ordinary method)
F. Animal reference pointing to a Dog object calling makeSound() → RUN-TIME POLYMORPHISM (dynamic dispatch through base reference)
